audience: owners and managers of Egyptian private-tutoring centres (سناتر) who today reconcile attendance, fees and the cash drawer by hand at the end of each day
promise: Hessa answers the four questions of the day — who attended, who paid, who owes, what is in the drawer — and puts the whole centre in front of the owner's eyes
cta: راسلني واحجز عرض البرنامج — the owner's own poster CTA; no contact details on screen
direction: One hero object, the app's amber dot, hops down four questions then becomes a student, a flood, a toggle and the logo tile. Worlds per chapter (ink, navy, amber, paper, night). Alexandria display + IBM Plex Sans Arabic for the UI. 120 BPM original score with a rising question motif that resolves on the logo.

assets.rights: Screens of the owner's own Hessa product (public repo, fictional sample data); used only as the reference the UI is rebuilt from, never placed in the film

creative.viewer: a centre owner at the end of a long day, adding up cash and paper
creative.problem: four questions every evening, answered from notebooks, receipts and memory
creative.promise: the four answers are one tap each, in one record that cannot be quietly edited
creative.evidence: the product's own screens (reception check-in, payment + receipt, dues list, close shift) and the owner-approved first-sale promise; all data fictional
creative.motif: the amber dot as ball, student, coin, toggle and logo tile
creative.light: worlds per chapter: ink, navy, amber, daylight paper, night; soft UI shadows
creative.camera: locked frame with slow push-ins on holds; short impact shake on the hook landings and the logo hit
creative.motion: springs with squash and stretch, container morphs, FLIP list sort, seeded wave, counters
creative.sound: 120 BPM kick from the first frame, hop notes E-G-A-C, cursor ticks, receipt printer chatter, vault-like close, full motif on the logo
creative.pacing: one idea per bar; holds 1.5–2 s for each answer line
creative.payoff: the four answers become the owner's poster line: the logo tile, حِصّة, «سنترك كله قدام عينك», «برنامج لإدارة السنتر»

shots.purpose: name the owner's four evening questions; the amber dot hops down them like a bullet list

craft.audioCue: kick from frame 1, four rising hop notes

copy.text: مين حضر؟ مين دفع؟ مين عليه فلوس؟ والدرج فيه كام؟

shots.purpose: who attended: one check-in button becomes a dot, a wave lights the student field and the counter

craft.focal: the button, then the lit field

shots.purpose: who paid: a receipt prints; a reversal prints beside it instead of erasing it
who owes: rows spring into order by amount; the cursor flips the world to night
what is in the drawer: cash counted by denomination until the difference is zero
the four answers become one clear record: logo tile, name, tagline, invitation

craft.audioCue: riser into 20.0, full motif on C
